items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: when I went into Cafe Society it was Barney Josephson had left

ctx.x: When did he go in there?

Well, I guess he must have gone in thereabout 1941 because he was in there until 1950 and when I went into Cafe Society it was Barney Josephson had left and most of the big stars that had started at Cafe Society, that era was over. It had changed hands and shortly after that it had closed down completely.
But as I said before, I met Cliff in 1950 again at Cafe Society and I reminded him of the time when I came to New York, which was 13 years
